title: My Project
subject: Me
summary: In this portfolio entry, I talk about my final school project.
body:
## Building a PC Case for My Mini-PCs

I chose this project because, at the moment, the mini-PCs I own are sitting on a random shelf where they collect dust. Because of that, I decided to build a case that can fit all of my mini-PCs. This should help protect them from dust. I also plan to add some fans to keep the PCs cool.

## What State Is the Project In?

At the moment, I have just started thinking about a design for the whole case and how everything should fit inside it.

## My Resources

Right now, there aren't many resources to show because I don't need much information for designing the case. However, later in the project, when I start building the case and working with wood, I will need to research how to do that properly.

## Open Questions

1. How should I manage the cables inside the case?
2. How should I handle the power supplies for the PCs?
3. Which parts can be 3D printed?
4. How much space will everything need?
5. Will temperatures be a problem?

title: Welcome to the portfolio
subject: General
summary: This example entry shows how a piece of work is presented. You can edit or delete it in the admin area.
body:
## How does this work?

Every entry on this site lives in `data/entries.json`. The page loads that file at runtime and builds the overview from it — there is **no** HTML per entry.

### Creating new entries

1. Open `admin.html` (deliberately not linked from anywhere).
2. Enter your GitHub Personal Access Token.
3. Fill in the form, drag images into the drop area and save.

> After saving it takes about a minute for GitHub Pages to publish the change.

### What Markdown can do

- Lists, **bold**, *italic* and `code`
- Links such as [github.com](https://github.com)
- Headings, quotes, tables

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | Subject, shown as a filter |
| `tags` | Keywords used by the search |
| `coverImage` | Image shown in the overview |

Umlauts, accents and emoji 🎓 work without any trouble, by the way.
